hypotheses.E0_dynamic_composition_is_exact: The complete analytic Layer-16 MLP plus dynamic Layer-17 two-QK derivative agrees with an independent autograd JVP to relative error at most 1e-5.
hypotheses.E1_dynamic_attention_is_a_small_boundary: The complete dynamic and frozen-attention endpoint derivatives have fidelity at least 0.95 on every corpus.
hypotheses.E2_dynamic_endpoint_rank16_atlas_is_suff: A fixed rank-16 dynamic endpoint atlas retains at least 0.90 oracle-projection fidelity on every corpus.
hypotheses.E3_common_local_operator_survives_dynami: The frozen mean local operator retains at least 0.80 through dynamic attention on every corpus.
hypotheses.E4_factorized_local_program_survives_dyn: The exact-read 64-mode inner-rank-8 local program retains at least 0.90 through dynamic attention on every corpus.
hypotheses.E5_inner_rank8_preserves_the_dynamic_pro: The inner-rank-8 program is within 0.05 of the full-inner-rank 64-mode program on every corpus.
hypotheses.E6_dynamic_program_transfers_ood: The inner-rank-8 OOD fidelity is within 0.05 of FineWeb.
hypotheses.E7_contextual_correction_remains_materia: The full 64-mode local program improves on the common mean operator by at least 0.05 on every corpus under dynamic attention.
